title: Wireless client (C9800)
description: One wireless client (picker: MAC, from the WLCs' telemetry): where it is, signal, rates, throughput, retries and errors over time.

list.name: wlc
list.label: WLC
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "wlc", tag: "source",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-process-cpu-oper:cpu-usage/cpu-utilization", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "wlc", tag: "source",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-process-cpu-oper:cpu-usage/cpu-utilization", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

list.name: client
list.label: Client (MAC)
list.query:
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/common-oper-data" and r._field == "ap_name" and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> unique(column: "client_mac")
  |> keep(columns: ["client_mac"])
  |> rename(columns: {client_mac: "_value"})
list.definition:
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/common-oper-data" and r._field == "ap_name" and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> unique(column: "client_mac")
  |> keep(columns: ["client_mac"])
  |> rename(columns: {client_mac: "_value"})

list.name: client_cisco
list.query:
import "strings"
import "array"
m = strings.replaceAll(v: "${client}", t: ":", u: "")
cisco = if strings.strlen(v: m) == 12 then strings.substring(v: m, start: 0, end: 4) + "."
  + strings.substring(v: m, start: 4, end: 8) + "." + strings.substring(v: m, start: 8, end: 12)
  else "${client}"
array.from(rows: [{_value: cisco}])

panels.title: Client
panels.description: The selected client now (empty when it isn't associated). Download/upload over the last 3 minutes.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "regexp"
import "strings"
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/common-oper-data" and (r._field == "ap_name" or r._field == "co_state" or r._field == "ms_radio_type") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.client_mac == "${client}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["source", "client_mac"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({mac: r.client_mac, ap: r.ap_name, state: r.co_state, source: r.source,
      band: if strings.containsStr(v: r.ms_radio_type, substr: "24-ghz") or strings.containsStr(v: r.ms_radio_type, substr: "24ghz") then "2.4 GHz"
            else if strings.containsStr(v: r.ms_radio_type, substr: "6ghz") or strings.containsStr(v: r.ms_radio_type, substr: "6-ghz") then "6 GHz"
            else "5 GHz",
      protocol: strings.replaceAll(v: regexp.findString(r: /dot11[a-z]+/, v: r.ms_radio_type), t: "dot11", u: "802.11")}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/dot11-oper-data" and (r._field == "vap_ssid" or r._field == "current_channel" or r._field == "ms_wifi/wpa_version" or r._field == "ms_wifi/auth_key_mgmt" or r._field == "ms_assoc_time") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.ms_mac_address == "${client}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["source", "ms_mac_address"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({mac: r.ms_mac_address, ssid: r.vap_ssid, channel: r.current_channel,
      security: r["ms_wifi/wpa_version"] + " " + r["ms_wifi/auth_key_mgmt"],
      connected: float(v: uint(v: v.timeRangeStop) - uint(v: time(v: r.ms_assoc_time))) / 1000000000.0}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/traffic-stats" and (r._field == "most_recent_rssi" or r._field == "most_recent_snr" or r._field == "speed" or r._field == "current_rate" or r._field == "spatial_stream") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.ms_mac_address == "${client}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["source", "ms_mac_address"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({mac: r.ms_mac_address, rssi: r.most_recent_rssi, snr: r.most_recent_snr,
      speed: r.speed * 1000000, mcs: r.current_rate, nss: r.spatial_stream}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 10m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/traffic-stats" and (r._field == "bytes_tx" or r._field == "bytes_rx" or r._field == "data_retries") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.ms_mac_address == "${client}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 3m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["source", "ms_mac_address"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({mac: r.ms_mac_address, down: r.bytes_tx * 8.0, up: r.bytes_rx * 8.0,
      retries: r.data_retries}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/sisf-db-mac" and r._field == "ipv4_binding/ip_key/ip_addr" and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.mac_addr == "${client}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({mac: r.mac_addr, ip: r._value}))

panels.title: Signal
panels.description: RSSI (dBm, at the AP) and SNR (dB). Below about -75 dBm / 20 dB, rates and retries suffer.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/traffic-stats" and (r._field == "most_recent_rssi" or r._field == "most_recent_snr") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.ms_mac_address == "${client}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "most_recent_rssi" then "RSSI (dBm)" else "SNR (dB)"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Download (sent to the client) up, upload down. Counters refresh every 90 s.

targets.query:
every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 3m) then v.windowPeriod else 3m
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/traffic-stats" and (r._field == "bytes_tx" or r._field == "bytes_rx") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.ms_mac_address == "${client}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (if r._field == "bytes_tx" then 8.0 else -8.0) * r._value}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "bytes_tx" then "download" else "upload"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

defaults.noValue: Client not seen in this time range (pick a client / WLC)

panels.title: Retries, drops and errors
panels.description: Per second. data_retries are frames the AP sent again; tx_total_drops frames it gave up on; decrypt_failed/mic_* point at key or security problems.

targets.query:
every = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) > int(v: 3m) then v.windowPeriod else 3m
from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/traffic-stats" and (r._field == "data_retries" or r._field == "tx_retries" or r._field == "tx_excessive_retries" or r._field == "tx_total_drops" or r._field == "decrypt_failed" or r._field == "mic_mismatch" or r._field == "mic_missing" or r._field == "duplicate_rcv" or r._field == "policy_errs") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/ and r.ms_mac_address == "${client}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

defaults.noValue: Client not seen in this time range (pick a client / WLC)
